content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Madras University Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.unom.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Madras University for filling up vacant positions under its department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Guest Lecturer under the Department of Medical Biochemistry.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Guest Lecturer position in this notification cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Biochemistry or Medical Biochemistry along with a Ph.D in any life science discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled-in application form is 05 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for Madras University Recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted in offline mode either by post or via email to the designated department address.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed in the official notification released by Madras University for this post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected based on their performance in the interview conducted by the university selection committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications along with bio-data and certificates should reach the department before the deadline or can be emailed to [email protected].
